answer: Randomized Duty Windows. Each epoch, a public verifiable random function assigns agents to short-lived roles whose schedule stays sealed until a dawn checkpoint, so an attacker cannot predict which identities will be sampled. At the river relay, only the sampled agent may act, and colluding clones must hold real idle capacity across every window. A knoll of redundant clones therefore pays full operating cost each round while only one earns, making mass duplication economically self-defeating.
